mapper.insert: insert into Orders (memberNo, ticketId, ticketTitle, ticketBranch, finalTotalPrice, orderStatus, paymentMethod, orderDate) values (#{memberNo}, #{ticketId}, #{ticketTitle}, #{ticketBranch}, #{finalTotalPrice}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{orderDate})

INSERT INTO OrderDetail (orderNo, optionId, optionName, totalPricePerOption, quantity, optionStatus, usedDate, barcodeNumber) VALUES
(#{detail.orderNo}, #{detail.optionId}, #{detail.optionName}, #{detail.totalPricePerOption}, #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.optionStatus}, #{detail.usedDate}, #{detail.barcodeNumber})
